integrity: All displayed constants follow from the explicit two-Laplace tail formula and analytic Taylor expansions. Numerical checks are supplementary and are not used as proofs of infinite or local statements.
scientific_limitations: The exact two-variable convolution law is classical; the claimed contribution is the combined fixed-variance local phase diagram and endpoint crossover. The result is restricted to two independent standard Laplace variables, and no uniqueness of the interior minimizer or global maximality of the endpoints is asserted.
title: Exact three-threshold weight phase diagram for two-Laplace tails
